verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS inbox with built-in AI features, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or guarantee that customer data is excluded from AI model training. The only related item says the assistant runs on the user's own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini API key. That is an adjacent architectural detail, not a documented no-training control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
